responsibility: This file is the empty implementation companion to the minimal SYSTEM definition module in gm2-libs-min. Its role is simply to provide a concrete implementation unit for the compiler’s built-in SYSTEM interface, because the actual functionality is supplied through special front-end handling and declarations in SYSTEM.def rather than executable runtime code.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of the SYSTEM pair, but unlike SYSTEM.def it contains no exported machine model declarations or builtins; it exists solely as an empty implementation module backing the compiler-special SYSTEM interface.
